description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'UpgraderCompleteController' within the OrangeHRM project, specifically part of the installer upgrader module. The class extends an abstract controller to handle the pre-render logic for the upgrade completion screen, setting up components and logging the upgrade status.

classes.name: UpgraderCompleteController
classes.description: A controller tasked with managing the display logic for the upgrade completion screen during the installer process. It sets up the front-end component with the current product version and updates the application state, while also logging the upgrade status.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the upgrade complete screen by creating a component, setting its properties with product version info, updating the state container to reflect the current screen, cleaning previous state, and logging the installation status.
